newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Arthuis - dollar has room to rise, DM/Ffr rate right.
newsitem.headline: Arthuis - dollar has room to rise, DM/Ffr rate right.

text.p: French Finance Minister Jean Arthuis said on Sunday there was no reason to change the parity between the franc and the mark.
He repeated, however, that he believed the dollar had room to appreciate.
"The (exchange rate) bewteen the mark and the franc is equitable," he told Reuters Financial Television. "There is no reason to change the rate."

His comments echoed a joint statement made last Thursday by French Prime Minister Alain Juppe and German Chancellor Helmut Kohl that the current mark-franc rate was in line with economic fundamentals.
On Wednesday, former French president Valery Giscard d'Estaing had called for a sharp depreciation in the franc to boost growth and employment.
Arthuis repeated that "there is some margin for appreciation of the U.S. dollar. This is another problem," he said.
He was speaking after a meeting of EU finance ministers which agreed to bring the lira back into the European Exchange Rate Mechanism (ERM).

Earlier Luxembourg Prime Minister Jean-Claude Juncker said that EU ministers had not discussed any exchange rates other than for the lira at their talks in Brussels. -- Brussels Newsroom 32 2 287 6800
